title: 🚨 MEV NFT 🚨
tagline: The ultimate NFT protection by using MetaMask Snaps! Exposing to the user all the necessary NFT activity data from Coinbase Cloud and QuickNode!

prizes.placement: ✨ Metamask — Best Metamask Snap Runner Up
prizes.title: MetaMask

description:
MetaMask Snaps provides a new ways how to protect digital assets against malicious transaction injection in a web page. We are 
- providing additional analytics data about NFT via Goodle Chrome plugin by injecting html code in a web page
- showing Transaction Insight data inside MetaMask before user sends it to the network
- sending Flashbot transactions in a more user friendly way
how_its_made:
Project uses Google Chrome extension for html code injection and MetaMask Snaps latest functionality. Tenderly Simulation API to see if a transaction has Transfer events. Gnosis safe for increased protection in a case if private keys are compromised.
The goal of the project is to increase protection for a regular NFT user and the new functionality of MetaMask Snaps is the core technology for us.
